Flagship build · BIMA Core

One AI core. Multiple products and interfaces.

BIMA started from a practical question: instead of building a different AI brain for every product, could one reusable core handle context, models, tools, safety and execution?

Product OwnerProduct DesignerAI-assisted BuilderQA
  • DeepSeek primary with Gemini fallback routing.
  • Durable memory and isolated project/domain context.
  • GitHub-aware guarded workflows, testing and CI.
  • Autonomous debug → edit → test execution.
  • HTML builder, image capability and deployment integration.
  • Security gates designed around explicit approval for risky actions.
Explore BIMA case study
Problem. Multiple products needed AI capabilities without duplicating logic, memory and safety rules.

Approach. I designed BIMA as a reusable intelligence layer: model routing, memory, tools and permission boundaries sit in the core while products remain separate interfaces.

Build process. Architecture → smallest working capability → isolated validation → regression → security review → staging/production deployment.

Why it matters. New products can reuse the same intelligence foundation while maintaining domain and client isolation.
